tools.name: create_trial
tools.description: Reserve a free 1 GiB, 30-minute proxy trial using an inbound from get_service_info. Returns an ID and secret access_token. This has side effects, consumes a slot, and is not idempotent. If ready is false, poll get_trial_status. Never publish or log the token.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Discover available VLESS Reality and Hysteria 2 proxy trial inbounds, quota, duration and available capacity. Free; no authentication.

tools.name: get_trial_connection
tools.description: Return a secret VLESS or Hysteria 2 connection link for an active trial. Requires its ID and access_token. Never publish or log the returned link.

tools.name: get_trial_status
tools.description: Get a trial's expiry, approximate usage and active state. Requires the ID and secret access_token from create_trial. Keep both private.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_trial" references sensitive artifacts (secret, access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
